', '                       Think of the weeniest, most pathetic man you know. Now put him in a leisure suit, throw him into a health resort with a whole host of  babes  and arm him with 100 corny pick-up lines. I have just given you the premises of the Sierra game, Leisure Suit Larry 6.                       Larry Laffer is your basic techie dweeb, thrown into a big bad world of (gasp ) women, of whom he is freightened to death. The producer of this game, Al Lowe, creates this world with admittedly lousy graphics, tacky humour and a touch of absurdity, so in the end you re left with a cross between Johnny Bravo and the Simpsons. Chics with dicks, naked bungee jumping and bondage are just some of the things you stumble upon. And the aim of the game? To get Larry laid                     The most bizarre thing about this is that almost anyone can enjoy it. You don t have to be a guy who equals getting Larry laid to having himself get some (we all have someone in mind when we say things like that, don t we?). The only prerequisites are a mouse, a slightly twisted sense of humour and an openness for the sexually bizarre. No matter what your sex or sexual orientation may be, you suddenly find yourself addicted to solving those puzzles to have this guy score.                       Everyone will have a day when chasing spaceships through virtual planets and attacking three-headed dogs in graphic dungeons just isn t that appealing anymore. Leisure Suit Larry 6 is made for that day. You throw down your imaginary spear and you don your leisure suit; you grease your chest, pull out your cheesiest pick-up lines and start making your moves      ', '    I bought my children a Ninentdo 64 game console three years back and during that period the only game that I  8217;ve actually every played with them was Fifa2000 (I always choose Brazil).However that was not until Mario Golf came along.They insisted that I play a game with them and after playing just once I am now an addict.I never really liked golf and found it rather boring, but after playing this game you get to understand what golf is about and I have now taken an interest in the game and watch it regularly on television.You select a character and the more you play the better he gets and the more enjoyable it becomes.The game offers match play, tournament play and practice rounds.The interaction between the players is humourous.The more rounds of golf you play, you gain experience points and then can customize what you want your character to improve on.There are many games available today but only a few get you addicted like this (especially to 37 year old  8217;s like me).This game would genuinely help you play real golf, if you ever decided to take it up, as you begin to understand other things other than just hitting the ball, such as wind speed, wind direction and type of club to use, ground slopes etc etc.I give this one a Thumbs Up. s5_annotated_personalized_summaries:
If you’re the kind of player who loves diving deep into strategy and simulation games with a healthy dose of management challenge, Theme Hospital (PC) is a classic worth your time. This game nails the balance between running a quirky hospital and juggling limited resources, which means you’re constantly strategizing how to keep patients happy without bankrupting your virtual healthcare empire. The ability to save your progress and play at your own pace is a godsend for those of us who appreciate a long-term engagement without feeling rushed—perfect for fitting in a few rounds between other gaming marathons.

One of the standout features is the staff management system. Hiring and managing employees with different skills isn’t just a side task; it’s a core gameplay loop that adds layers of depth and complexity. You’ll find yourself weighing who to hire, when to train, and how to keep morale up, which keeps the game fresh and engaging. It’s like running a hospital-themed chess match, where every move impacts your bottom line and patient care.

That said, while the game’s charm and strategic depth are undeniable, don’t expect cutting-edge graphics or multiplayer modes. Theme Hospital is a single-player experience with retro visuals that might feel dated compared to modern titles. If you’re someone who thrives on online competition or co-op chaos, this might not scratch that itch. Also, the interface can feel a bit clunky by today’s standards, so patience is key as you get used to the controls.

In summary, Theme Hospital offers a quirky, challenging simulation that rewards thoughtful planning and persistence. It’s a nostalgic gem for strategy fans who enjoy managing complex systems at their own pace, even if it lacks multiplayer bells and whistles. If you’re after a game with personality, depth, and a dash of humor, this one’s worth a shot—just don’t expect to race through it or play with friends online.

You   re going into a squalid flat to arrest some drug dealers with three other armed officers, you   re nervous, it   s dark and   .it   s absolutely pissing down   What atmospherics.And so it goes with the next five chapters that I   ve managed to complete so far.   From creeping around breakers yards trying to peel off members of a Latvian drug and people-trafficking gang, to haring around London   s streets trying to arrest said gang members, the realism and detail of the graphical aspect of this product is stunning.  The streets of London, as in the previous game, are based on the real streets and as such look every bit the part, right down to the congestion charge logos and bus lanes on the road surfaces.  Pictures were taken of the real streets and then graphically manipulated to fit in with the gameplay and action.  This took two years for the last game and eighteen months this time around.There are a couple of little added extras in this follow up too.  There   s a free-roaming mode that, after collecting some hidden keys in each chapter (level) you can unlock this feature and pootle around London mindless of the usual time restrictions imposed on such tasks.  There are more characters this time too.  Whereas the original featured the heads of the various London gangs (Triads, Yardies etc), this time around we see several levels of the Russian and Latvian mafias along with bent coppers and double-crossing molls.Along with the realism, comes the language.  There   s lots of    shits    and    fucks    and even the c-word, whilst not actually spoken, appears in a cut scene as a subtitle.  Hence the very sensible 18-rating of this game.All good?  Well, no, not exactly.  As with all epic projects such as this there are bound to be negatives to match or outweigh the positives.  Firstly, I got stuck behind a flower pot     of all things      on the roof of the first level.  The game just seemed to have that little gremlin in its midst that would not allow me to come out from behind the pot.  As such, I got shot to buggery by some sniping Latvian.  The coward.Then there   s the missions/chapters.  Yes, there are 24 of them but after only a couple of hours    play I was up to chapter 6: that   s a quarter of the way through the game.  I seem to remember spending most of Christmas 2002 and all of January 2003 getting that far in the previous game, which was equal parts frustrating and rewarding.  Just how a game should be.  Perhaps I   m better at this sort of thing these days, but I feel that so far the chapters have been too short and too easy.Lastly, the cut scenes.  These are the little    filmed    sequences in between the chapters that segue the storyline and give you pointers and clues as to what the next chapter/mission may involve.  Again, they   re very detailed and the intricacy of the characters    features is astounding, but I find them too long.  Some go on for three minutes or more.  When you   ve just taken out a whole posse of drug dealing bastards, the last thing you want is a cut scene where, for half of it, the characters are just making smalltalk in a car or a caf   .  You just want to get on with it.Overall, with only being a quarter of the way through the game, I can   t comment on the game as a whole.  However, take it as read that the gameplay and graphics will remain consistent throughout and that the invention of the creators of The Getaway: Black Monday remains creative and groundbreaking.Thanks for reading.Wayne.     ', '    This is a review on the newest Getaway game called The Getaway: Black Monday. This is the first review I have done on these types of games, so please bare with me, and I hope that I make a lot of sense  I shall be talking about the previous game a bit so you know what   s going on, and what   s happened, and I will talk about the actual game itself.-------------------------------------------------History-------------------------------------------------Previously on the Getaway, Mark Hammond (main character), is recovering from the death of his wife, and the kidnapping of his son, he then helps out these gangsters as he was previously one of them. He does all sorts of things, including disobeying the law, illegal actions were done. As Mark got really pi  ed off, he got his gun, and then went on a full attack against Charlie Jolson (the gangster he was forced to help out). You will still have the option of doing the Cop missions, if you so wish.-------------------------------------------------Story Of Black Monday-------------------------------------------------Black Monday, the newest Getaway game. Still with the same character Mark Hammond, yet you are now a police officer, fighting crime, so this has some disadvantages since now you can   t pick up any weapon you like as you have been issued with a certain weapon. You will be able to pick up ammo, but you will not be able to do that manually, Mark does that when he is low on ammo, and you go by the right ammo for the weapon you are using.There are 3 characters playable on this game, which you will be able to unlock when you finish one characters mission, then another character will be unlocked, but I will not talk about them as it will spoil the surprise for those who have not got them yet.There are loads of missions to do which will be done side by side, you will not be able to roam around as such, and you will be forced to do the missions first before hand. Every mission which involves driving, you will be the driver, so better get your glasses on, because you will need to be prepared for anything out there. When both of them are on, that means that you are at the destination you are meant to be at.There are some new stuff to this game, like being able to ride motor bikes, and better weapons, but that is pretty much the new features, maybe some new vehicles also, but the missions are very good -------------------------------------------------Controls-------------------------------------------------The controls are easy to get use to, but I will tell you what the controls are if you are a beginner or planning on getting this game. That is the basic controls for the Moving around and shooting.Controls For Driving:Its pretty much the usual controls for this really. There are voices in this game, so best to listen to the game then just watching it, also there is a lot of bad language in this game so that   s why it is an 18 and should not be good for children.The game is not that difficult at start, but it does get much harder later on throughout the missions, but you will be able to complete the mission eventually though, just can get annoying for a while.The game is great value for money, you can get is for the cheapest price I   ve seen is    20, which I think was at play.com or tesco.com or something like that, but great value though.I shall give this game a 4 star rating * * * *, as I have seen better games, yet the game is still very good, could have had better things, but I just don   t know what at this moment of time. I recommend this to most people, but not for kids, unless they are use to this type of game, but then its up to your parents.Thanks For Reading DBZKing     ', '    Game InfoGenre = Action, Shooting, Driving (Free Roaming Game)Developer = Team SohoPublisher = SonyPlayers = 1 PlayerOnline = NoAge = 18+Memory Usage = 62KB MinimumReleased = November 2004---------------------------------------------------------------==HISTORY==Team Soho is a group of team members that s part of the big company Sony, This is only there 2nd game they have made which is a sequel to  quot;The Getaway quot; and currently making the 3rd game in the series for the next generation in the form of Playstation 3.STORYBlack Monday does not follow on from the previous game and that you now follow the story of a boxer called Eddie. Eddie and the gang decide to rob a valuable item from a rich and powerful gang boss which is dealing with weapons trade and other stuff. Along with Eddie you also play levels with a young girl called Sam, plus Mitchell which is part of a special attack unit in the police. All there story s link and cross paths together the plots twist and ends up different to what they are after.GRAPHICSAlmost 2 years after the release of the first getaway the graphics has not been improved much if at all, although it s not the worst you can find. You will find that all the characters are well designed with detail faces but you may also notice that animations has glitches where there is not movement from the mouth or is not accurate. The detail in the buildings is pretty plain and flat, which don t look good but as your mostly driving you will not notice this and it will look fine. Ones inside of the buildings, you can see that there developers have put more details into everything as here you will obviously be on foot.With most action games you will not see real cars as it cost to license them. As Team Soho is part of the company Sony which has a lot of money can afford to put in real cars, this is way you will get not only to see but drive cars from makers of Peugeot, Vauxhall, Lotus, Rover, TVR, Renault, Mitsubishi and many more. Along with the nicely detail cars you also have damage that will show up from bullet holes, smashed windows, scraps and when it has taken to much damage the car smokes and slows down. As before they are trying to make it look real, with no stats what so ever on screen to show life, ammo or anything.SOUND/MUSICI start with the sound first, the gun shots and car sounds are ok but not what you would get if it s a shooter or racing game. The music seems alright with some of the missions you play have got good tracks or tunes but you mostly find that there s not enough and can be quite boring with out. As with other games you get that atmosphere and more entertainment if the music is done perfect but not here.On to the voices now, I don t know if it s because it s set in London or that the developer is trying to make it feel more like a game but there is just too much swearing in the game. Although the dialogue is very well write it seems that every sentence not only in the cut-scenes but while playing the game, that the characters speak has to have a swear work in it. One more thing I mention here is that I found in one or two situations where when I was playing as the main male characters that it was the voice of the female characters over lapping. For those that have not played it, it s basically the same layout as other games of its type. With the handling of the cars and bikes are very sensitive, it s hard to drive with them: you will be hitting a lot of vehicles, some sudden skids and revising it pretty much imposable. One more thing is that there are no tips, instructions or any type of tutorial, so you will need to read the manual at least once.GAMEPLAYThe gameplay is just like the previous game, although there is a new storyline and characters, the game does not offer anything new apart from that you can now drive bikes but that has no effect on the gameplay. One being hit by a car only a bit will make you spin out and out of control. But where as hitting a solid lamppost or metal railing will make you slide out the way or suddenly move with out taking damage even though you defiantly hit it.Onto the shooting side, when your moving around in buildings shooting people the auto lock on aim seems to be always on the wrong person. So if you thinking manual aim be better its not as with the developers real feel to the game you have no aim curser to see were you are shooting. So unless you re a robot you end up using a few clips on one person were only a few bullets will hit. Along with the bad camera angles most of the time, it just makes it more difficult and least enjoying.The worst bit of the gameplay is were you control the girl called Sam, were all her missions are to do with stealth. Don t get me wrong here, I love stealth games but it s made so bad here you ll be praying to get of these parts. As Sam don t fight or use guns, along with the camera angles and even people spotting you when they shouldn t its almost imposable to do these parts, even me a heavy gamer taken me many re -tries. To finish this off the healing situation is still the same weird odd way were you have to wait a second for your character to lean on the wall for the blood and bullet damage to disappear, although there is now a few medi-kits, yes that s right a few in the hole game on wall for you to use instead of the weird lean on wall healing way.REPLAY-VALUEWith the main game if should take at the most a week to complete but I done see any reason to replay again but like before there is a roaming mode where you can does drive around doing what you like and try and find some of the secret cars. Along with that you get a few more extra modes over the previous game like race, chase, and black cab. These modes may add more days or weeks of replay value but I couldn t cope with the controls anymore so I managed to pay only about half of the races.---------------------------------------------------------------==BUY OR NOT TO BUY==From what I can tell they have just put in new characters, storyline, new vehicles plus bikes right on top of the original game. If you had a chose from the 1st or 2nd game, I go for the original even if it was a few more pounds to pay as this sequel has not added anything new or good the game.---------------------------------------------------------------SCOREGraphics - 8/10Sound/Music - 8/10Controls - 5/10Gameplay - 7/10Replay Value - 5/10FINAL RATING - 6.6/10Amazon.co.uk = Sold Out, but Market Place from    1.70Play.com =    9.99 (Platinum)---------------------------------------------------------------Website Linkswww.blackmonday.co.ukwww.thegetaway.co.uk---------------------------------------------------------------Thanks for reading.     ', '    The Getaway: Black Monday is the sequel to 2002 s hit The Getaway. Set in current day London the game again delves into the world of English gangsters and the cops that chase them but this time offers a (sort of) non linear storyline that you get to shape  as well as improved driving and fighting controls. Continuing the approach from the first Getaway, the developers have mapped lots of Central London to give the game an authentic feel. The Getaway Black Monday somehow manages to capture the grimy  quot;feel quot; of Central London, as well as being an accurate map. Vehicles and non player characters all go about their business in Central London whilst the plot unfolds around you. The game kicks off as the first day back at work after a two year suspension for Sergeant Mitchell from the Mets Organised Crime Squad, and dives straight into an urban shootout with gangsters. There are three playable characters in the game Sergeant Mitchell boxer Eddie O Conner and Sam a street thief. The storyline in the game jumps back and forth between the main characters weaving a complex plot similar to a Guy Richie movie. With over 25 actors and over an hour of cut scenes to help explain the developing plot  The Getaway: Black Monday is a game that blurs the lines between movies and videogames to try and create an semi interactive adventure for players but its really just guiding you along a fairly linear plot. Whilst the fighting and driving controls are much improved compared to the original Getaway the improvements are let down by dodgy camera angles poor vehicle physics and weird collision detection. Sometimes it s hard to directly face your enemies in order to shoot them and at other times you can be blocked from moving by some small object in your way. Driving is also a pain as most of the vehicles handle badly and all the other cars always seem much faster than you. Although this is a lot better than the original Getaway it does get frustrating especially when you compare the game to other similar titles which seem to manage such tasks a lot better. Inevitably The Getaway: Black Monday will be compared to other games such as the Grand Theft Auto series and True Crime, and rightly so. If the developers want to make a non-liner action game then they need to learn from others in order to avoid common mistakes. On the whole The Getaway: Black Monday doesnt improve on these games and in many cases repeats the same mistakes. The Getaway: Black Monday is a good game that provides fun for a day or so but it isn t particularly challenging nor a great step up from the first Getaway game. For fans of the first game it   s a great sequel and worth checking out but the real fact of the matter is that GTA San Andreas is simply better executed and more fun.      ', '    Following up from the first  quot;Getaway quot; game, Team Soho have returned to have another shot with  quot;The Getaway: Black Monday quot;. They must be either stupid or must dislike themselves very much. See the thing is, you just don t dabble in this market - not if you have any sense anyway. You have to have a pretty high opinion of yourself if you think that you re going to blow the contemporary Grand Theft Auto game out of the water. In fact, chances are you ll be attacking it with a peashooter and it ll turn around with a nuclear missile and erase you from existence. So what has this new Getaway game got that makes it think it can compete? Frankly, not much.The storyline isn t bad, but it s not great either. Taking control of  quot;copper quot; Mitch, you get yourself involved in drugs raids, minor street warfare with foreign and homegrown gangs and basically have the worst day of your life. Not really inventive, and not really connected either - the various different parts of the plot seem to be woven in just because the makers fancied sticking it in there.The world around you is well realised, set in London, Team Soho have recreated their original feat of mapping the actual city into the game. That s great and I m very impressed but when it comes down to it, I don t care because it has very little impact on the game. The characters on the whole look good, but why is it that the hero has to be missing a neck and is about four foot tall?I m pretty indifferent to the gameplay too. Whilst it s pretty good in itself, the camera has a tendency to get stuck behind walls or spin wildly at the wrong moment and there s no direct control over it like there is in GTA. The end result of that is that my language turns as foul as the characters on-screen. The cars are also very hard to control and despite the images that you can see, they still feel like boxes on wheels. Furthermore the damage that appears as you crash into things is well below par.The free-roam mode is good for a laugh (for a short time anyway), allowing you to wander pretty aimlessly around London, but also allowing more interaction than you ll achieve by following the storyline. I ve run out of things to say, which is a bad state of affairs for something that you re expected to part with    45 for. Black Monday is, if you can see it on its own merits, a good enough game, but there s a problem for any game of this type - GTA. If the Grand Theft Auto franchise had died before making the transition onto the new generation consoles, this review would have a much more positive spin, but it didn t, and it s raised the bar of expectations massively. Black Monday simply can t keep up.I ll not recommend this game, but what I will recommend is that you spend your money on the only other game in this genre.     ', '    I eagerly anticipated the follow up to Team Soho s 2002 smash hit  The Getaway , but now after completing the game with minimal effort I feel disappointed and a little bit cheated.This time around you play three characters rather than just two like in the original. However, it doesn t work particularly well. Unlike in the original where you played Mark for exactly half the game while catching brief glimpses of Frank before swapping over and seeing events through his eyes, Black Monday does not do this. It never really gives you a chance to connect with your character and you don t really care about his or her story.Sam especially, never develops as a character, you only play her in a few missions and you view her as the whiny brat the other characters believe she is, rather than the brilliant hacker. Mitch is also not in the least bit likeable. With his trigger happy tendencies and no emotion over than to kill any and all criminals. Eddie is the only one who you feel some attachment to, an ordinary guy whose friends are killed. Much like with Mark in the first game whose wife was murdered, you feel you need to go out and avenge their deaths.Generally the game gives an overall impression of being rushed. As if it had to be released around the same time as Grand Theft Auto San Andreas (it was released three weeks after the GTA game). It was if they wanted to jump on the GTA bandwagon and attract more gamers to their  quot;similar quot; game. It makes you wonder if it s success would have been more or less if it was not riding on the back of GTA hype and had a later release.Sadly the problems from the first game are still there, the camera randomly moves and the auto targeting is still a bit dodgy. There are some improvements including a lot more vehicles, sports cars are widely available and bikes are introduced. However, the bike controls take a lot of getting used to, and you can crash quite easily.  Free Roam  mode is now available from the beginning of the game which is nice as if you are new to the game it can take a lot of getting used to where things are. Previously in  The Getaway  you had to complete the whole game before accessing this feature. Throughout Black Monday you can collect car keys which opens up races, taxi driver and chase mode to play as side missions. Also as you make your way through the game, the characters you come across will become available to play as in  Free Roam  mode.Games like  The Getaway  series would benefit from including extras such as  quot;the making of quot;,  quot;trailers quot;  quot;photos quot; etc much like the game  Primal  does as you progress through the story (ironically the failure of  Primal  has been blamed on  The Getaway  as it s release date was pushed back many times and more money was spent on promoting  The Getaway ).Improvements in the game include the ability to look behind and to the sides while driving, and you now can shoot while driving too. Also missing from the first game was a map, which could get confusing at times especially in free roam mode. Although it does feel as though Team Soho copied this from GTA. They missed out a map from  The Getaway  to make it more realistic, so you really didn t know where you were or where you were headed.The missions are not a patch on those of the original, with it s riot, car park shoot out, torching a restaurant, a gun battle on a boat etc the ones here are rather dull, and the final mission in just a case of finding and killing your enemy. However, we are introduced to some exciting new places such as the Underground system, although sadly it is not accessible in any other part of the game.The graphics are still some of the best around, with extreme realism and neutral colours you could almost be there yourself  Music is used well again, with a continuous soundtrack through which fits the mode of each mission and area.If there ever is a Getaway 3, I hope that all bits from previous games are there and accessible (the museum, the underground, the car park) etc but that it brings a whole new side of London with it too. The characters need to go back to being like in the first game, that they have a purpose and you actually feel a need to help them.Overall, a very good game on its own but as a sequel it is disappointing.     ']

The Getaway: Black Monday for PS2 offers a visually impressive dive into London’s gritty streets, with highly realistic and detailed graphics that truly capture the city’s atmosphere. For a fan like you who values immersive environments and high production quality, this is a definite highlight. The game also expands its narrative scope by introducing three playable characters with intersecting storylines, adding depth to the storytelling and providing varied perspectives—a welcome evolution from its predecessor.

Gameplay-wise, the early missions are notably entertaining and addictive, which helps draw players in quickly. Additionally, the wide variety of licensed vehicles, from cars to motorbikes, enhances the realism and offers diverse driving experiences.

Which considering the cost of 6.49 I haven t being using it all that excessively. ** Pregnancy and breastfeeding **The public are told that there is no evidence of associated side effects for those women that have been using 4head and are pregnant of breastfeeding. However as there doesn t appear to be any research actually done on this fact I would advise seeking advice from a medical practitioner before using. ** Warnings **You should not use 4head if you are sensitive to the active ingredient levomenthol.The only recorded side effect is that it may cause hypersensitivity, which can include the reaction of contact dermatitis. Which is a skin reaction that happens when you have been exposed to something that has irritated your skin or induced an allergic reaction. If though, when you have applied 4head you feel uncomfortable or are experiencing any undesirable effects, then you should seek medical advice immediately taking with you; the stick and the information leaflet.  When using 4head you should make your self aware of the expiry date. Also it advises you on the labeling that storage should be below 25 degrees c.  ** Misc ** When trolling the Internet for more information to share with you all, I found out that the levomenthol is extracted from mentha pipertia which is one of the medicinal plants that are in the 4head garden 2004 (which is sometimes called  Merlin to Medicine ) see picture below ** Where can you buy and how much? ** 4head is sold in boots, asda, sainsburys, superdrug, Morrison, Lloyd s pharmacy and in other independent chemists. These prices obviously vary from store to store but all range from approx 6 - 7 pounds. My family acquired mine from a local boots and it cost 6 pounds and 49 pence. Which I guess for an effective natural pain killer that has 100 applications in one stick isn t bad. Though 9p for 16 paracetamol is MUCH cheaper.  *************Personal view, *************There is more of a need for the natural cure than there ever was as more and more research is being carried out saying that some analgesia is addictive (codeine for example) and that by taking medication you are actually causing your self more headaches as explained by Dr Kirby, (in the Independent Newspaper On June 2, 2003) when she states that many of her patients suffer from  rebound headaches  if they take too many painkillers.Also in the same article:  Medication overuse is a major risk factor for daily headache,  explains Dr Silberstein.  You might think that if you use painkillers regularly, you d have no pain and no problems. But the body gets used to them and its own natural painkilling systems get turned off.  Dr MacGregor agrees.  The body produces natural painkillers; if you re taking external painkillers, why would your body keep producing? If you suppress nature s pain control, once you stop taking the tablets, bang  You get a headache. All of which makes me want to use the natural formulas even more. ** Does it work?? **When you buy 4head I do think it s important to assess what type of headaches you are having. As for me 4head is only effective for the tension type headaches and more severe or migraines need the treatment of prescription medication, and the manufactures of 4head do stated it is produced for tension head aches. Generally when I have a headache smells do tend to get to me, and the overpowering menthol smell was a little of putting at first. (though I appreciate that the active ingredient is levomenthol so they cant do anything about the smell). Though when my mum and sister first gave me this I was skeptical but once I had applied to my forehead: it immediately made my forehead cooler and the sensation that it gave was pleasant. It really did seem to loosen knotted muscles in my forehead making me more relaxed. This feeling lasted for me about 5 mins and then it seemed to produce a numbing effect that seemed to stop my headache (I assume this is due to the stopping of the pain transmitters). The effect of 4head seems to last me about one hour and therefore I will re-apply after that. But as I was in hospital at the time of first using this, the effects it had allowed the pain to dull sufficiently for me to be able to go to sleep with is my best cure for headaches anyway.I do feel that the price is quite high despite the 100 doses that you can get, I feel that if it was cheaper than more people would use it and stop some off the nasty side effects of other oral medications.  All in all I would recommend 4head to those that so suffer from minor tension headaches as it is quick and effective to use and the fact that its so portable makes it very practical for all those with busy lives. So there you have it, hope that it s been informative    Mair x     ', '    I ve been suffering from a few headaches lately that tablets just don t seem to shift. Never in my life have I gone to bed with a headache only to find it still there the next morning, and I was getting quite miserable. I guess I have been complaining quite a lot about it, because my mum popped over to present me with a 4head stick, telling me that while she hadn t used one herself, people at work swore by it. I was willing to give anything a try to end my misery, although my dad, who is a pharmacist, was exceedingly skeptical and told me that it would do nothing more than a wet flannel. (Although, of course, when it did work, he gave me a spiel about how they have been using menthol for years to treat headaches...go figure ) The stick is essentially what looks like a short, wide glue stick, with a cap and another inner cover (not sure what it does but we ll keep it ). It is small enough to pop into any bag or pocket. It twists up, to reveal a miniscule amount of the product itself if I m honest, which looks almost like a block of ice really, and somehow made me feel confident about it s cooling effects  The stick works by applying it to the forehead (duh )  quot;as required but avoiding excessive use quot;. Helpful. I have no idea what they consider going overboard, but I apply pretty regularly when I ve got a bad head and have been known to apply when I haven t because the tingling is fun...is that weird? Anyway, I just applied some for reviewing purposes (this is probably what they mean by excessive) and the stick glides on smoothly without leaving any residue at all, let alone sticky or greasy which I was half-expecting. The stick smells pretty whiffy, but I like the menthol smell so it s not a problem for me. I will say that if you do touch your forehead (like I did to test for stickiness ), don t rub your eyes as it does sting  After a couple of minutes, the cooling kicks in and it feels oddly pleasant. Not so much wet flannel, which is good because to be honest if I m applying this in an everyday situation in the office or what have you I don t want to feel like I have a wet face. It s more the feeling you would have if you went for a run around after washing your face or something, a  quot;wind on damp skin quot; kind of cool, which is pretty soothing without being distracting. After a few more minutes, the analgesic effects take hold, and I must say this has helped me through headaches that I couldn t shift with Paracetamol or Ibuprofen. Its direct application means it gets working really quickly, and the cooling gives you something else to think about in the meantime  The stick costs    4.99 and is available from most chemists or supermarkets. While this seems expensive compared to the pennies you would pay for own-brand tablets, bear in mind that the seemingly-tiny amount of product is going to last a seriously long time. You feel no residue and it honestly feels as if nothing has transferred off the stick so I can t see it wearing down at all to be honest. Therefore it should last its entire shelf life, which for my stick is three years. This product can be used by anyone over the age of six, and I suppose is aimed at those who dislike or have trouble taking pills. I don t, but if they aren t shifting my headache and this is I m sold  Obviously with any product applied directly to the skin there might be the odd person who suffers from an allergic reaction, but this is true of tablets also, and I see this as a useful addition to any medicine cabinet.      ', '    My working days are spent staring at a computer screen and as I like to have the window blinds open, and the infra-red stitched fluorescent lights can t be turned off  my screen often has a fair amount of glare on it. As a result I often get headaches, although for some reason they come in bouts - I ll not have one for ages, then I ll have one every day for a week.The headaches seem to vary in intensity, from just a mild muzziness which is clear with some paracetamol, to almost migraine types which just wipe me out. Generally I am don t mind taking tablets, but sometimes I have run out or the pills just won t shift it, so having seen the TV advert I thought I would give 4head a go.4head comes as a stick (think of the lipsalve type stick by about 2 / 2.5 times the diameter and half the height). After removing the cap and twisting the bottom to elevate the white, waxy type stick, you apply thinly to the forehead area.The stick contains and smells strongly of menthol (or levomenthol to be precise), the same substance that is use to relieve that bunged up feeling you have with a cold. This clearing effect seems to provide some relief even before applying the 4head, one applied you forehead is left feeling cooled and soothed. For me, just a minute or so the headache generally starts to ease, however if my headache is extreme I do have to take some paracetamol to finally get rid of it. 4head is not cheap, at between    5 and    6.50 (but this should last quite a while) and as mentioned above it doesn t always work on its own. However for me it is handy to have in case there are no pills to hand.     ', '    4head - 3.6g - The Miracle cure to natural headache relief. I am always a bit suspicious when buying a new product, especially one that claims how brilliant it is, and natural without any prescription medication. However that is not how I was introduced to 4head. Sitting at my nan s one Sunday afternoon, I had a headache brewing (slight but had the potential to get worse). I asked for some paracetemol when my nan handed me a little pritt-stick type device and told me to rub it on my head. Rub it on my head I did and after 2 minutes, I started to get a weird sensation on my forehead, it smelt of vicks but felt like I had a layer of gel accross my head sticking out about half an inch, obviously this was not the case but I was totally bemused. I then went to a local superdrug and asked for 4head, I was told it was    7 approx.    7 I thought for a tiny little device was extortionate. Although I paid the price anyway as I thought this would be a great cut down on paracetemol. Surprisingly I brought my first 4head about 4 years ago (if not a little longer) and I am only half way through my second stick. I was gobmacked at how long it lasted. 4head really works, I never completely trust something  hurbal or alternative  but I would reccommend 4head, it helps if you have a headache brewing and can nip it in the bud before it even starts and even with a full blown headache it can completely get rid of it. I suffer from migranes and strong headaches and although I think this is great, it doesn t always kick a full blown headache for me, but does make it far more managable. As for migranes, I have tried it a few times but it doesn t seem to do a lot, but I d say it helps. WARNING: Watch your eyes  I Often put 4head on before bed or in the evenings (as that is when I get headaches) but I then tend to lean on my partner and he quite often ends up with it in his eyes, and making a big fuss. Be careful because it does sting if it gets in your eyes, I have wiped my forehead before and then realised after wiping my eye that I had some on my hands. Ouch         ', '    I am unlucky enough to be plagued with headaches and migraines. They seem to come in bouts and can last up to two or three weeks, which drives me mad  I hate taking painkillers all the time, so when I saw 4head advertised a year or two ago, I thought it couldn t hurt to try it. The product comes in a stick that basically looks like a short, fat Prittstick. It is silver with the pink 4head logo on the front and a see-through lid. The stick is about 2.5 inches high. When you take off the lid there is a secondary cap over the end - I m not sure what the point of this is, but I keep mine on, just in case it dries out or something. The product itself is white and reminds me of white Kendall mint cake. To apply the product you screw up the stick from the bottom and run it over your forehead or the bits of your head that are aching. It feels slightly greasy but you can t tell it s there once you ve put it on. After a few seconds you can feel it taking effect, it starts to tingle on your head. It is a pleasant cooling sensation. For any of you who have used tiger balm on aches and pains, the feeling is reminiscent of this.One tip I would give is not to apply the product too near your eyes because it really makes them sting and start to water  After a while, the sensation starts to ease your headache and the smell of the product (a fresh, minty/menthol smell) relaxes you, although some people might find the smell a bit overpowering. The product can be reapplied as necessary as long as you don t use it excessively (although the packet doesn t tell you what excessive use would be ). However, this product is NOT a miracle worker.I have found that it only relieves a headache, it does not rid you of it completely. I have also found that the product only really relieves tension headaches. I have tried it on migraines, but it just doesn t do anything. I still need strong painkillers for this. However, I do enjoy the sensation so I usually take painkillers and also apply this for its cooling properties.4head does not come cheaply. It costs around    5-6 but it does last for ages  I have only ever had one lot - the stick never seems to go down  So it is worth the price if it works for you, but I guess you don t know if it will work for you unless you fork out first  You can buy it from chemists and all the usual places for medicines and the like. I would say that this is a good product as it is a natural remedy with healing properties, but it won t work for everybody. My advice would be to try it and see.     ', '    Hey folks if like me you get fed up of popping pills every time you get a headache then this is the product for you. its combination of menthol and geranium oils help to soothe and relive the pain of a headache. 1 stick last ages, though if you are passing wilkinsons then they do their own version of this product at a much lower price. 99p for exactly the same product. There is also a similar product on a liquid form available from good health shops, which is called migrastick, it comes in a little glass bottle so not ideal to carry around in your pocket as i do with my stick. But this version contains mint and lavender. Ideal for bed time use. The mint in both products has the effect of cooling the skin and it also helps to clear the sinuses. apply to your forehead, temples and the nape of your neck. I find that it seems to work much quicker for me that pills do. And far healthier too. I am a fan of alternative therapies over drugs where ever possible as the side effects are much less, and they dont tend to damage my immune system in the same way as drugs.I would recomend that you do a skin sensitivity test prior to using the product, just in case your skin does not agree with the ingredients.     ', '    I have suffered from migraines / headaches for years and though at my age I really should be able to take / swallow tablets I just can t bring myself to take them so am always looking for an alternative.One day I was complaining of a headache when my friend pulled this out of her bag, though I had heard of it before I was still a little unsure of what it was and how I was expected to think that this could actually work.I was pleased to see that it worked very well and was soon off to buy myself one, however, when coming to the supermarket I was shocked to find that one of these little and yet I mean little sticks was    5.50, however, if it meant I was to avoid taking tablets than ANYTHING is worth it The tube itself is very small, only a few inches tall and is round like a size of a 10 pence piece. The first thing I noticed about this was the smell as it is quite a distinctive and strangely familiar scent. It has a rather minty menthol small, yet also smells like Vicks, which I guess is why it is much a familiar smell. The main component of this to target pain is that of numbing the affected area and the thing that does this is the levomenthol.To look at 4head looks like a clear-white solid, maybe even greasy looking stick. It looks like the same consistency of a lip balm and does look much like a bigger version of one of these. Due to it being greasy I was a little wary when putting it on, in case I got big greasy marks wiped from side to side across my forehead, however, even with close inspection I could see any left over residue of this on my forehead.I was also fussing incase it removed any of my make up, which would leave me looking all patchy and the stick with a horrible orange tone to it, but this didn t happen  either. My make up stayed in place and the stick remained the same colour.When first put on it does feel a little weird. It starts after about 10 or so seconds on me, however, friends have said it can be almost immediate or some say up to a minute or so for the tingling sensation to last. I can not say that this a pleasant sensation and neither is it an unpleasant sensation, but it is just a tingling sensation that is there.After about 5-10 minutes I found that this became a cooling sensation to the forehead where my head felt slightly cold, numb and more relaxed, quite a pleasant sensation and not one to be mixed up with that of brain freeze It does not tell you how much to use, I just tend to go over my forehead once or twice and find that this is enough, though, it does say not to overdo it. When using this I definitely can see an improvement, if you catch it quickly it near enough every time works for me and within 20 minutes there is almost nothing there.If I don t catch it as early I find it still works well, however, does not completely get rid of it and only does work as a number and will need to be reapplied should you find that the effects wear off.I was a little disappointed, yet not surprised, that it doesn t work on migraines. I suffer from these quite regularly since the age of 6 and that even the likes of paracetamol and nurofen (when being pinned to the floor with my nose pinched in order to take them) cannot always get rid of these  I would not say particularly that this would work on anyone s migraines or severe headaches as it is more of a natural remedy and is just not strong enough to cope with theseAs I have said, there is not really any guidelines on how much you should use, though, I would check with a doctor/GP if you have severe problems, pregnant, etc just to make sure that it is suitable for you.I have had my own tube of this for almost 4 months now and still have over half of it left. It hasn t become dry or unusable either, which is always a plus.I would definitely recommend this item. It has worked for me, though I do think it depends on what sort of headache you are suffering from and whether or not you can nip it in the bud early enough Though the price may put some of you off, as I know there are much cheaper medications on the market, this is definitely a more natural remedy and lasts much longer than some of those do This review is also on dooyoo under thye same username.     ', '     Overall View:I like this product alot, although it seems very similar to a thing which I often use called Tiger Balm, which is much cheaper, and probably works just as well.Does it Work?:That would be a yes, and not only that, but it works quite quickly too.  I would say that once I have applied it my headaches seems to have disappeared within about 5 minutes maximum.Not only does it get rid of my headache, but it also perks me up a bit too.  About 20 seconds to a minute after you have applied it you find that the area on which you have applied it starts to tingle and feels really cold, yet slightkly hot at the same time if that makes any sense what so ever  It is a very strange sensation, but it certainly takes your mind off yiour headache for a while.  By the time you have gotten used to the feeling and start to think about your headache again you find that the headache has actually eased already.  The strange feeling also seems to perk you up a little as I mentioned earlier, so whne you find that your headache has made you lethargic and you just want to go home from wherever you are...the office, shopping etc 4head gives you that extra boost which makes you able to continue on through your hectic day.I personally sit in front of a computer all day as part of my job.  My job is also quite stressful, so I find that I often get tension headaches.Is it convenient?:Again, that would have to be a yes.  It is in quite a small stick form (about half the height of a lipstick, but about twice the width of lipstick) therefore it is very convenient to slip into your handbag, workbag, make-up bag, whatever you tend to have with you most of the time (probably a bit too bit to pop in a purse or wallet though).You simply twist the tube to get the part with the active ingredients in to show, and wipe it over your head.  I would suggest only making one wipe from one side of the head to the other, and I would do it just above the halfway point of your eyes and hairline, otherwise the tingling sensations tend to make your eyes water, and feel a little too uncomfortable if you put too much on.  You can always add more once you get the sensation if you find that you need more.You do not need anything else to take it, whereas tablets often need water, it works much quicker than tablets, and it is a natural remedy, made with essential oils.Cost:4head costs approximately    5.00.  Although this seems quite a high price, it is worth bearing in mind that it lasts for ages, and in the grand scheme of things it costs much less than having to keep buying tablets.Where to buy:It is available in many shops.  It is on sale in most chemists, in supermarkets and on various websites.If you are looking for it on the shelves it comes in a megenta (dark pink) box with the words 4head in white (see picture above)      ']
